label: EDPB Guidelines 2/2019 — Art. 6(1)(b) for Online Services
body: • Art. 6(1)(b) "necessary for contract" requires the processing to be objectively necessary for a purpose which is integral to the delivery of that contractual service. If the same service can be delivered without the processing, contract basis fails.
• Service improvement is NOT covered — relying on contract basis for product analytics is wrong.
• Fraud prevention typically not covered — separate Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation or Art. 6(1)(f) LI required.
• Online behavioural advertising is NOT covered — needs consent, not contract.
• Personalisation of content may be covered, but only if integral and explicit in the agreement; generic engagement-driving personalisation isn't.
Codified by CJEU C-252/21 Meta v Bundeskartellamt: contract basis applies only where the processing is "objectively indispensable for a purpose that is integral to the contractual obligation".
